ProgramUnit.Name: DO_SAVE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DO_SAVE IS
 alert_msg varchar2(200) := 'Are you sure you want to change the password for user ' || 
 :ctrl_blk_1.user_id || ' ?';
 alert_ret number;
 commit_stat varchar2(100);

 added_prefix varchar2(10) := chr(73)||chr(68)||chr(69)||chr(77)||chr(69)||chr(82)||chr(65)||chr(87);
 new_pw varchar2(30);

begin
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.user_id is null THEN
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.user_id');
 show_error('0080');
 END IF;
 IF :new_password is null THEN
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.new_password');
 show_error('0080');
 END IF;
 IF :conf_password is null THEN
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.conf_password');
 show_error('0080');
 END IF;
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.new_password != :ctrl_blk_1.conf_password 
 THEN
 show_error('16000');
 END IF;
 set_alert_property('choice_alert',title,'CAUTION');
 set_alert_property('choice_alert',alert_message_text,alert_msg);
 alert_ret := show_alert('choice_alert');
 IF alert_ret = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
-----------------------------------------------
if ltrim(substr(:new_password,1,1),'0123456789') is null then
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD');
 :ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk_1.CONF_PASSWORD := NULL;
 message('Error: First letter of password must be alpha');
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 elsif ltrim(:new_password, 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ') is null then
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD');
 :ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk_1.CONF_PASSWORD := NULL;
 message('Error: A minimum of one numeric character is required');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 elsif length(:new_password) < 6 then
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD');
 :ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk_1.CONF_PASSWORD := NULL;
 message('Error: Minimum length of password is 6 characters');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 elsif ltrim(:new_password, '0123456789') is null then
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD');
 :ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk_1.CONF_PASSWORD := NULL;
 message('Error: A minimum of one alpha character is required');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 
 
 

------------------------------------------------
 BEGIN
 update system_users 
 set password_modified_date = null
 where user_id = :ctrl_blk_1.user_id;

 default_value('ABC','GLOBAL.passwd');

 check_password(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid, commit_stat);

 IF commit_stat = 'N' THEN
 show_error('1377');
 END IF; 

 new_pw := added_prefix||:CTRL_BLK_1.NEW_PASSWORD;

 FORMS_DDL('ALTER USER ' || :ctrl_blk_1.user_id || ' IDENTIFIED BY '||new_pw);

 check_package_failure;


 EXCEPTION
 when others then
 message('Error in updating application password');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end; 

 show_error('1379');
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 check_package_failure;
exception
 when form_trigger_failure then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_STRONG_SAVE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 2012/06/01 12:27 (Formatter Plus v4.8.5) */
PROCEDURE do_strong_save
IS
 hashing RAW (50);
 pw VARCHAR2 (80);
 cn VARCHAR2 (80);
 msg VARCHAR2 (300) := '0';
 ERROR_CODE VARCHAR2 (100);
 added_prefix VARCHAR2 (30)
 := CHR (73)
 || CHR (68)
 || CHR (69)
 || CHR (77)
 || CHR (69)
 || CHR (82)
 || CHR (65)
 || CHR (87); -- Wing 6/20/00
BEGIN
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.new_password IS NULL
 THEN
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM ('CTRL_BLK_1.NEW_PASSWORD');
 show_error ('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF lt_password_policy.is_strong_password
 THEN
 -----------------check password complexity----------
 lt_password_policy.check_strong_password (:ctrl_blk_1.new_password,
 ERROR_CODE,
 msg
 );

 IF msg != '0'
 THEN
 GO_ITEM ('CTRL_BLK_1.NEW_PASSWORD');
 :ctrl_blk_1.new_password := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk_1.conf_password := NULL;
 display_errors (ERROR_CODE, msg);
 RETURN;
 -- RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 IF NOT lt_password_policy.check_password_history
 (:ctrl_blk_1.user_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.new_password
 )
 THEN
 :ctrl_blk_1.new_password := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk_1.conf_password := NULL;
 GO_ITEM ('CTRL_BLK_1.NEW_PASSWORD');
 show_error ('16313', ' CHOOSE A NEW ONE');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 DO_CHECK; -- New_password field validation is done in do_check; -- for regular passwords 
 END IF;

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.conf_password IS NULL
 THEN
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM ('CTRL_BLK_1.CONF_PASSWORD');
 show_error ('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF :ctrl_blk_1.new_password != :ctrl_blk_1.conf_password
 THEN
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM ('CTRL_BLK_1.NEW_PASSWORD');
 :ctrl_blk_1.new_password := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk_1.conf_password := NULL;
 show_error ('1377');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

------------------------------------------------------------
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 15;
 hashing := lt_password_policy.save_hash (:ctrl_blk_1.new_password);

 UPDATE system_users
 SET reset_request = 'Y',
 password_modified_date = SYSDATE,
 lifetrak_password = hashing
 WHERE system_users.user_id = :ctrl_blk_1.user_id;

 IF lt_password_policy.is_single_user_mode
 THEN
 BEGIN
 UPDATE lt_password_history
 SET reset_date = SYSDATE
 WHERE user_id = :ctrl_blk_1.user_id AND reset_date IS NULL;

 -- Modified insert stmt on 04/24/2014; SCR 20552; encrypt password and store as hash.
 INSERT INTO lt_password_history
 VALUES (:ctrl_blk_1.user_id, hashing, SYSDATE,
 NULL);
 /* 04/24/2014; SCR 20552 ; 
 INSERT INTO lt_password_history
 VALUES (:ctrl_blk_1.user_id, :ctrl_blk_1.new_password, SYSDATE,
 NULL);
 */

 COMMIT;
 END;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 pw := added_prefix || :ctrl_blk_1.new_password;

 UPDATE system_users
 SET reset_request = 'Y',
 password_modified_date = SYSDATE
 WHERE system_users.user_id = :ctrl_blk_1.user_id;

 UPDATE lt_password_history
 SET reset_date = SYSDATE
 WHERE user_id = :ctrl_blk_1.user_id AND reset_date IS NULL;
 
 -- Modified insert stmt on 04/24/2014; SCR 20552; encrypt password and store as hash.
 INSERT INTO lt_password_history
 VALUES (:ctrl_blk_1.user_id, hashing, SYSDATE,
 NULL);
 /* 04/24/2014; SCR 20552 ; 
 INSERT INTO lt_password_history
 VALUES (:ctrl_blk_1.user_id, :ctrl_blk_1.new_password, SYSDATE,
 NULL);
 */
 FORMS_DDL ( 'ALTER USER '
 || :ctrl_blk_1.user_id
 || ' IDENTIFIED BY '
 || '"'
 || pw
 || '"'
 );
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 END IF;

 COMMIT;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 0;
 show_error ('1379');
 EXIT_FORM;
--PASSWORD_MESSAGE('Password Changed Successfully');
--
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 MESSAGE ('error in updating application password');
 check_package_failure;
END;
